impact-donut.looks: A heading, text and a 2x2 set of large figures with labels on the left; a donut chart with a legend on the right; up to two buttons.
impact-donut.use: How a whole divides into parts (e.g. 80% of spending on programmes) beside headline figures.

fields.itemType: stat for a figure on the left; segment for a slice of the donut.
fields.chartValue: The number for the donut maths, e.g. 80. Segments should add up to 100.
